title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in POSIMYTH…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in POSIMYTH Innovations UiChemy up to version 5.5.3. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers with limited privileges to execute malicious scripts in the context of other users. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.5, indicating a medium severity level.
